keyNotes: Map: seed Z2tNDhy0Ht, not the comparison seed U8Qxgisp4I: no town pairs with the 0119 / 0302 runs; compare map-level medians only. Start 2552 buildings (0119 / 0302: 1701), SIMGROW year-40 target 100272 persons (0302: 42969; Chipping Campden alone 39364, growth x16.95).

Speed: Quick 231 s = 30 quiet years 21.8 s + 10 fill years 209.6 s (fillS 197.8, roundS 181.1 overlapping, sizesS 6.9). The fill forces ~1800 buildings per fill year at ~90 buildings/s; 18170 added in all (0302: 6238). Per 1000 buildings added: 12.7 s (0119 14.5 s, 0302 28 s): no regression, a bigger job. Builds inside the rounds took 1.6 s median (0119 / 0302: 0.34 s): they share the frames with the early fill.

Young towns branch out again: all 226 CHECKs under 1800 persons read mat=0.00 demK=1.00; why=free 0 of 406 (0302: 235 of 279); 116 demand builds in the first 20 years, 189 round builds; the mod built 22 % of the edges (0119 24 %, 0302 11 %).

Grown towns did not build up: mat passed 0.5 at 2700-3500 persons on 9 towns and demK fell to 0.19-0.70, but pb median 3.08 (0119 2.94, 0302 6.33; aim 4-5 for grown towns); only Chipping Campden 5.27. LEVELS set 0: skip=young early, then skip=player on 8 grown towns, because every original town carries engine-set custom level weights (ALLTOWN c:) the mod never sent.

Offshoots: 10 satellite seeds (+2 grow builds), 5 districts (Chipping Sands, Bexhill-on-Sea End, Windermere Green, Ellesmere Cross, Birchwood Bay; all kind shore; 4 linked, Chipping Sands swallowed by its parent, link why=back), 2 Works (Kirkby Lonsdale Quarry, Heywood Sawmills; both linked). All how=name+pos, 7 distinct ids, forest 0.03-0.16. 0 OFFSHOOT turns: every CHECK needed streets, so the decisions ran at demand builds.

Form: spread median 1.24 [1.19-1.32] (0119 1.19, 0302 1.12); 5 towns >= 1.3 (Windermere 2.66, Bexhill-on-Sea 1.94, Burgess Hill 1.50, Darley Dale 1.40, Ellesmere Port 1.30). Bridges 3 built / 1 failed, coastal picks 2, lead lanes 3, no stops on the map.
